aboutSite.title: About this site
aboutSite.description: Born from the struggle of retaining and accessing my learning and coding experiences, Apinant.dev serves as my digital archive. Here, I share my journey through the bleeding-edge of technology, capturing and transforming fleeting knowledge into accessible wisdom. May Apinant.dev guide you in your coding journey, much like a compass in the vast ocean of technology.
aboutSite.closing: Dive in, enjoy, and I hope you find it as useful as I do.

rebrand.title: VoidBox is now Apinant.dev
rebrand.description: This blog used to live at voidbox.io. It now has its own domain, blog.apinant.dev, and the name moved with it. Every article is still here; only the name and the address changed. If you bookmarked or followed the RSS feed at voidbox.io, please switch to blog.apinant.dev.

aboutAuthor.title: Apinant U-suwantim (Moo)
aboutAuthor.description: Hello, I'm Moo. I'm an enthusiastic developer and programmer based in Thailand, with a growing interest in languages and tools like Rust, Go, Lua, Astro, Cloud-related and many more along the way. Presently, I am focused on my day job while dedicating my spare time to building a blog website to share my thoughts and the knowledge I've accumulated.
